market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely to remain volatile but net positive near-term as Waller's dovish tilt supports equities. However, oil at $97 and Iran escalation create a ceiling on risk appetite. Expect range-bound S&P 500 with sector rotation favoring energy, defense, and healthcare over high-multiple tech. Yen intervention risk is the key tail event to watch. Mortgage rates likely to stay elevated, pressuring housing and consumer credit.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if Iran conflict de-escalates and disinflation path holds. AI capex cycle remains structurally positive but valuations need to reset to fundamentals. U.S. fiscal trajectory (debt + AI borrowing) is the medium-term overhang. Labor market cooling supports eventual Fed easing. K-shaped economy persists, favoring quality and defensives. Energy transition (NextEra, Santee Cooper AI savings) is a structural theme.
